stem.text: Which statement supports the theory of active loading of sucrose into companion cells?

A.text: The pH decreases in the cell wall of the companion cells compared to the cytoplasm.

B.text: The pH decreases in the cytoplasm of the companion cells compared to the cell wall.

C.text: The pH decreases in the plasmodesmata between companion cells and sieve tube elements.

D.text: The pH decreases in the sieve tube elements compared to the companion cells.
